title: TWO DOOR CODES
yt_title: Two GTA 6 Door Codes: 0420 and 7700 (Donnie Jobs)
hook: Two GTA 6 codes you need on the Donnie jobs: 0420 and 7700.
tips: 1. Boutique back-room keypad code 0420 (xQc UfmrSYPbvfw 2778; subtitle 'The code is 0420' + Notes 0420 on frame 2780-2812)
2. El Tropical Private Club code 7700 (xQc UfmrSYPbvfw 2875 + subtitle on frame 2878; Typical Gamer cyAPzaLcEsM 1075 'Entry code is 770[0]')

parts.text: Two GTA 6 codes you need on the Donnie jobs. Zero four two zero, and seven seven zero zero.
parts.label: 0420  and  7700
parts.proof: subtitle 'It's in the backroom! The code is 0420' 2779-2784

parts.text: One. Brian sends you to a boutique to collect his rent. The owner says he doesn't have it, and gives up the code to the back room instead.
parts.label: 1  Collect the rent
parts.proof: boutique conversation 2764-2776 (xQc 2715 'Brian sent me over for the rent', 2769 'just take the acid')

parts.text: Two. The code is zero four two zero. Punch it into the keypad on the back room door. The game saves it in your notes.
parts.label: 2  Back room: 0420
parts.proof: subtitle 0420 2782; keypad on wall + Notes 0420 2806-2812 (xQc 2778 'THE CODE IS 0420')

parts.text: Three. Inside is an acid lab. Check the register for cash, grab what you can carry, then call Brian.
parts.label: 3  Acid lab
parts.proof: lab 2818-2848 (xQc 2817 'stove, bags', 2828 'finally some real cash'); phone call 2854 (xQc 2856 'How we looking, Jason?')

parts.text: Four. Next up, the El Tropical Private Club next door. Brian says put whatever you got in the strong box. The code is seven seven zero zero.
parts.label: 4  El Tropical: 7700
parts.proof: Brian call 2860-2878: subtitle 'lockup next door at the El Tropical Private Club' 2866, 'strong box' 2872, 'The code is 7700' 2878 (xQc 2866-2875; TG 1075)

parts.text: Zero four two zero, and seven seven zero zero. Screenshot this, then drop a comment with which job you're on.
parts.label: 0420  and  7700

desc_steps: 1. Brian sends you to a boutique in Vice City to collect his rent. Push the owner and he gives up the back room code: 0420.
2. Enter 0420 on the keypad on the back room door. The game saves the code in your notes.
3. Inside is an acid lab. Take the cash and call Brian.
4. Brian then sends you to the El Tropical Private Club next door. The code is 7700. Put what you have in the strong box.
Codes: 0420 (boutique back room), 7700 (El Tropical Private Club).
verify: Tip: codes 0420 (boutique back room) and 7700 (El Tropical Private Club).
